metaGate.question: 原视频还有哪种信息载体、意义变化或知识关系根本没被协议检查？
metaGate.rationale: The gap-free ten-region carrier sweep covers 0–16.556 seconds. Speech, SRT and burned-in text, every complete card line, gesture/gaze/reaction, motion and before/after state, likeness/styling/Apple symbol, result counts and layout, editing/global continuity, generic AI生成 labels, non-speech audio handling, and the absence of UI/parameters/handoffs were all inspected. OCR ran on every OCR/UI action and accepted/rejected rows were checked against frames. All six cues are accountable; global same-room continuity, parallel-list/not-pipeline structure, universal/one-click scope limits, three Manus grids, and the 即梦 image-to-animation bridge are represented. Remaining items are explicit unknowns, not unchecked available carriers.
